message: I returned to my room, but there wasn't much to do.
The dorms at Murakumo Academy are all single rooms, complete with a bath, a toilet, and even a kitchen.
In that respect, it's incomparably more luxurious than the JGSDF barracks.

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, since I've got a kitchen, why not make some fried rice！」
After all, I brought along <d0041>my own iron skillet</d> that I've lovingly seasoned, just for an occasion like this.

name: Iori
message: 「All right, all prepped and ready」
I stow the groceries I bought away in the fridge.
In the Tenju Special Forces Group, the squad members take turns cooking meals.
Maybe because we're a special forces unit, our daily routine is pretty different from the regular troops, even though we're stationed at the same base.
My specialty is fried rice, and I've even earned a reputation among the other guys for making especially good fried rice.

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm-hmm, hmm-hmmm♪」
Humming a tune, I quickly stir-fry the rice.

name: Iori
message: 「Ahh, cooking for one sure is nice and easy」
Whenever I cook at the barracks, I have to make at least twenty servings.

name: Iori
message: 「All right, done！」
I quickly dish it onto a plate and dig right in.
Mmm, delicious.
Maybe just a tad too salty. When you're only making one serving, even a little extra seasoning really shows in the taste.

name: Iori
message: 「Still... 'show me your leadership,' huh...」
As I eat my fried rice, I mull over what Keisetsu said to me earlier.
It was about two weeks ago that the Company Commander told me about this mission.
...It was a day off. I'd just gotten back from off-base and was taking it easy when she called out to me.

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Muragaki Iori, do you have a moment?」

name: Iori
message: 「C-Company Commander！」
A sharp salute, snapping to attention. To a rank-and-file soldier like me, the Company Commander is someone high above the clouds.
I probably haven't spoken to her directly since my commissioning ceremony.

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「At ease, we're off duty right now. You can relax」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, ma'am, understood」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「It's been almost five years since you joined the Tenju Special Forces, hasn't it？」

name: Iori
message: 「A little longer than that」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「I see. How are you finding it here?」

name: Iori
message: 「It's the best, ma'am」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Heh, don't say things you don't mean」
The captain looked down at her toes, remaining silent for a brief moment.

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「I heard from Mishima. You’ve been in a slump since that ‘<d0042>Oni-slaying</d>’ incident, haven’t you?」

name: Iori
message: 「That is……」
Several months ago—I, along with my team, headed out to suppress a certain incident.
The culprit was a single swordsman using Origami. Since the police couldn't handle it, a deployment request was issued to the Tenju Special Forces.
In the Tenju Special Forces, missions like these were codenamed “Oni-slaying.”

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Muragaki Iori, you carried out that mission perfectly. Your technique was truly excellent.」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Despite the scale of the commotion, there wasn't a single victim.」

name: Iori
message: 「……But, I ended up causing the culprit serious injury.」
The opponent was using Origami and had deployed a Barrier Jacket. Half-hearted attacks wouldn't be enough to suppress a culprit like that.
That’s why I didn’t hold back and struck with everything I had.
The result—the culprit lost their dominant arm and was, for a time, in critical condition.

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「The opponent was trying to kill you, too. It was well within the bounds of self-defense.」
I know that.
Even though I caused the culprit severe injury, I faced no disciplinary action. On the contrary, I was even commended at the general assembly.

name: Iori
message: 「But, he was still young. He was a student at the academy until just a while ago.」
The culprit I had wounded was a former student who had just graduated from Murakumo Academy.
Perhaps something had gone wrong for him; he drew his Origami on the mainland and began to rampage indiscriminately.

name: Iori
message: 「If I had only been able to persuade him properly, it wouldn’t have come to that…… Thinking about it just leaves me feeling so regretful.」
Clad in my full Spirit-Type Armament, the combat uniform of the Tenju Special Forces, I had stood against him.
The only way I could stop him was by hurting him.

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「……I heard you once wanted to become a teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「H-how did you know about that……！？」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Toru Kurachi from your squad told me.」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Apparently you were complaining about it while on sentry duty during a field exercise. That won't do; no idle chatter while on sentry duty.」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I am terribly sorry!」
That Kurachi, running his mouth like that. Just you wait……！

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Tell me, Muragaki Iori.」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「How about we try a little change of pace for a change?」

name: Iori
message: 「……And that would mean？」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「How about you try taking on an ‘errand’？」
A special appointed dispatch—commonly referred to as an “errand.”
It is a high-difficulty special mission involving tasks like solo infiltration investigations.
An “errand” is usually supposed to be reserved for those at the rank of Sergeant Major or higher who hold Special Agent qualifications. I fulfill neither of those requirements.

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Even though I call it an errand, the importance and difficulty of this mission aren't all that high.」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「What do you say, are you willing to take it？」

name: Iori
message: 「What are the contents of the mission……」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「The details of a special appointed dispatch can only be revealed to the operative being dispatched. That is what the service regulations dictate.」
In other words, they can’t tell me unless I answer 『I accept.”

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「I would say this is a mission perfectly suited for you.」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Go get some distraction, Muragaki Iori.」

name: Asagiri Midori
message: 「Wash off the filth of demon-slaying, and when you’re satisfied, you’re welcome to come back.」
……And so, the place I was dispatched to was this academy.
Helping out as a teacher was the nature of this “errand.”

name: Iori
message: 「It might be perfectly suited, sure, but……」
When I was told to do this “errand” and heard the details of the mission, to be honest, I wasn't thrilled at all.
It’s not like I lost the desire to become a teacher.
But, I have no qualifications related to Jindou.
It was precisely because I thought that, that I turned my back on Jindou and knocked on the doors of the JGSDF.
Yet, here I am, sent to this academy on a JGSDF mission, involved in Jindou, and doing the very thing I used to dream of—being a teacher.

name: Iori
message: 「……Is this what you’d call destiny, I wonder.」
Honestly, I have a lot of complicated feelings about it.
I can’t escape the guilty feeling that clings to my spine like a leach.
But, for the students, my personal circumstances don't matter at all.
If I were to cut corners, I wouldn’t be able to face them. If I’m going to do it, I have to give it my all.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, I’ll give it my all tomorrow too！」
Just as I was psyching myself up, a call chime rang.

name: Iori
message: 「……Huh, Sasaki-sensei？」
When I answered the call, a holographic Sasaki-sensei appeared before my eyes.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Were you in the middle of eating？ Sorry to bother you outside of work hours.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it’s fine. Did something happen？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I just remembered there was some data I forgot to hand over to you. I’ve shared it to the address I’m sending now.」
I access the address and open the shared data.

name: Iori
message: 「This is… the results of the quiz, right？」
The data was a list of the results from the quiz everyone in Takamura Class took in mid-April.

name: Mikoto
message: 「I’m sure you’re aware, but there’s a midterm exam at the end of June.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「However, I’d have to say some students are in quite a precarious position.」
The Murakumo Martial Festival is right after the midterms. If they fail the midterm, they can't participate in the Martial Festival.

name: Iori
message: 「……We’re going to need a strategy.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Exactly. I’d be grateful if you could do something about it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood. I’ll get on it right away.」
I hang up the call and shake my head. Good grief.
……Captain Asagiri did say, 'Go have some fun and clear your head,' though.

name: Iori
message: 「This doesn't exactly clear my head, though.」
I can’t help but offer a wry smile.
But it’s precisely because it’s a hassle that they’re endearing, and it makes the work worth doing.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, no use worrying about it. Time for action！」
I shovel the rest of my fried rice into my mouth and clench my fist.
